purpose: NEW PSI : ZERO DAY 현장도감 최종 상업용 비주얼 기준. 기존 픽토그램/아이콘형 이미지는 구조 참고용 placeholder이며 최종본이 아니다.

visual_language.camera: three-quarter isometric, slightly elevated, consistent 35–45 degree presentation
visual_language.form: real construction equipment/material proportions simplified into readable game pictograms
visual_language.material: painted steel, galvanized steel, concrete, rubber, timber and safety polymer with restrained highlights
visual_language.outline: clean dark navy edge definition; avoid comic black ink
visual_language.lighting: soft cinematic key + realistic contact shadow; avoid flat infographic lighting
visual_language.background: transparent alpha; no baked site photo or UI panel
visual_language.text_policy: no random labels or pseudo text; NEW PSI branding only when a readable company/site mark is naturally required
visual_language.branding_policy: NEW PSI is the only allowed readable brand; no real company, manufacturer, apartment or project branding
visual_language.framing: single object or one compact work-state diorama; centered with 8–12% transparent breathing room
visual_language.detail_level: more detailed than flat icon, less complex than concept-art scene
visual_language.primary_style: high-detail semi-realistic 3D construction asset / compact field diorama
visual_language.realism: materials, fasteners, joints, wear, edge thickness, deck/bracket/brace geometry and construction logic must read as physically believable
visual_language.composition: single object or compact work-state assembly, three-quarter perspective, transparent or neutral studio background; preserve construction context when required for comprehension
visual_language.material_detail: visible galvanized steel, plywood grain, painted steel, bolts, pins, clamps, welds, deck texture and realistic wear where applicable
visual_language.scale_readability: must look like real construction equipment at thumbnail and full-screen size, not a toy miniature or vector icon

validation: thumbnail at ~60 px must remain identifiable
detail preview must show the same object without switching art style
no floating generic warning icon unless the hazard itself cannot be represented physically
hazard/control meaning should come primarily from the construction object/state
existing final scene-element art is preserved unless explicitly replaced
reject: floating object with no believable joints or load path
symbolic geometry that omits actual construction details
generic AI construction object that cannot be identified by an experienced worker
acceptance_gate: an experienced construction worker can identify the exact object/work condition without reading the label
critical connection points and support/load path are visible
real materials and thicknesses are believable
image still reads clearly at field-guide thumbnail size
full-screen view contains enough detail to reward inspection
not acceptable if it visually reads as a pictogram or safety poster icon
